label: The service fails with HTTP 500
description: The service fails while handling the submission and answers HTTP 500 with an OperationOutcome, which PAS 2.0.1 allows in place of a bundle. The CRD sentinel P32H-ERR500 selects it too.
basis: Synthetic. An OperationOutcome, which PAS 2.0.1 lets the $submit and $inquire operations return in place of a bundle (input/fsh/ClaimOperation.fsh of the guide's 2.0.1 source). Its wording and the element it names are this project's. It has not been observed from the live service.

details.text: The service failed while processing the request.

issue.diagnostics: An unexpected condition prevented the request from being processed.
